mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, (SELECT g.title FROM support_goals g WHERE g.id = c.goal_id AND g.user_id = c.user_id) AS goal_title FROM goal_check_ins c
mapper.select: WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.user_id = #{user.id} FOR UPDATE
WHERE c.user_id = #{user.id} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 100
WHERE c.user_id = #{user.id} AND c.source_request_id = #{requestId} AND c.action_id = #{actionId}
WHERE c.user_id = #{user.id} AND c.source_request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY c.id
WHERE c.user_id = #{user.id} AND c.goal_id = #{goal.id} AND c.undone = FALSE ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 12
WHERE c.user_id = #{user.id} AND c.created_at >= #{start} AND c.created_at < #{end} ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id LIMIT 1001
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal_check_ins (user_id, goal_id, action_id, action_title, outcome, note, source, source_request_id, session_id, coaching_json, previous_status, applied_goal_version, feedback_added, undone, created_at) VALUES (#{user.id}, #{goal.id}, #{actionId}, #{actionTitle}, #{outcome}, #{note}, #{source}, #{sourceRequestId}, #{sessionId}, #{coachingJson}, #{previousStatus}, #{appliedGoalVersion}, #{feedbackAdded}, #{undone}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM goal_check_ins WHERE goal_id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user.id}
